findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced last week." followed by a list of only 3 items
findings.fix: Either add a fourth project to the list or change the count to 3.
findings.location: Section "Your projects", first paragraph and unordered list
findings.violation: The stated project count (4) does not match the number of projects listed (3).

findings.fix: Add visible text to the button, such as `<button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button">Duplicate</button>`.
findings.violation: The button contains no visible text content, only an aria-label, making it unclear to sighted users.

findings.fix: Either update this text dynamically with JavaScript when the name changes, or use a generic message that doesn't reference the project name.
findings.location: Archive confirmation section, paragraph with id="archive-confirm-copy"
findings.violation: The project name "Q3 Roadmap" is hardcoded in the confirmation text; if a user changes the name in the form above, this message would become inconsistent.

findings.evidence: `<form>` without action or method attributes (appears in three forms)
findings.fix: Add action and method attributes to each form, for example: `<form action="/api/save-project-settings" method="POST">`.
findings.location: Project settings, invite member, and notification settings sections
findings.violation: Forms lack action attributes, so they cannot submit data to a server.
